summary: Harden the production API, admin authentication, product uploads, runtime container and operational error handling
changes: Diagnosed the empty Shop All page as a static-hosting/runtime mismatch
Added a resilient seven-product storefront fallback when the public products API is unavailable or empty
Restored complete Product typing for created dates and best-selling sort counts
Added render.yaml for a Docker web service, private PostgreSQL connection, health check and persistent upload disk
Locked PostgreSQL external access while retaining Render private-network connectivity
Corrected deployment documentation to prohibit static-only production hosting
Completed a source-level usability audit after the hosted URL was blocked in the cloud testing browser
Rebuilt product detail pages with primary media, selectable thumbnails, quantity controls, stock messaging and expandable assurances
Added clear add-to-bag confirmation states and secondary-image hover previews
Upgraded the cart with linked products, line totals, quantity labeling, estimated total and checkout assurance
Upgraded checkout with autocomplete, submission locking, error alerts, item thumbnails and policy acknowledgment
Enhanced search with collection suggestions, result counts, loading treatment and a recoverable no-results state
Enhanced admin Orders with status tabs, counts, search and inline fulfilment controls
Rebuilt Shop All with breadcrumb-led hierarchy, a three-column product grid and responsive collection layout
Added collection, availability and naira price filters with clear-filter states
Added eight sort modes: Featured, Newest, Best selling, price, alphabetic and Oldest
Published seven named nail variations using the existing booking-page photography and placeholder naira pricing
Rebuilt the admin Products index with status views, search, counts, selection and bulk deletion
Introduced a Shopify-inspired two-column product editor for content, media, pricing, inventory, status and organization
Added multi-image uploads with a 12-image limit, primary-image treatment and per-image removal
Added permanent product deletion with uploaded-file cleanup and explicit confirmation
Improved responsive behavior, keyboard focus treatment, status badges and WCAG-oriented labeling
Enabled a restrictive Content Security Policy and production security headers
Added bounded in-memory rate limiting for owner setup, admin login, order creation and order tracking
Sanitized inbound request IDs and disabled Express technology disclosure
Hardened admin session cookies, expired-session cleanup and malformed-origin handling
Restricted uploads by field, count, size, MIME type, server-generated extension and file signature
Prevented internal exception leakage and added request IDs to safe production error responses
Added explicit API 404 behavior, no-store API caching and graceful database shutdown
Required production DATABASE_URL and a minimum 32-character SETUP_TOKEN
Hardened the Docker runtime with deterministic checks, dumb-init and post-mount privilege dropping
Added a private vulnerability reporting policy
deployment: Merge this hotfix so the current static storefront immediately displays the starter catalog
Create or sync the render.yaml Blueprint to provision the dynamic commerce web service
Move dejoyartistry.com from the static service to the new web service after health and admin checks pass
Retrieve SETUP_TOKEN from the Render web service environment and create the owner account at /admin
After merge, allow the Docker build to run npm run check before promoting the web service
Verify CSP, admin login throttling, uploads and graceful health checks in staging before moving the domain
